readiness_gates.decision: Proof claims must be machine-readable and cite exact files, commands, and expected results.
Every workbench state must declare authority source, allowed next actions, and forbidden downstream posture.
Canonical preview hash basis must be frozen before approval/revision/execution can depend on it.
Every state-writing endpoint must define duplicate and retry behavior before execution.
Approval, revision, and future execution transitions must be serialized by server authority, not browser state.
The return path from plan_revision_requested to an approvable preview must be explicitly frozen.
Approved-plan cancellation or supersession must be explicitly frozen or remain unavailable.
Datum/fact/finding/insight/caveat/result/package terms must be defined or deferred before results UI.
RAG/vector/upload/local-directory/qualitative/hybrid scope must be explicitly admitted or remain unavailable.
The next eligible implementation may create selected/not-started L3PassRun shell rows only after approved-plan and preview-hash validation.

The next eligible execution implementation must execute at most one existing selected/not-started L3PassRun shell through wrapped quantitative analysis, and must not call materialize_pass_entry(...) as-is or open result/package/handoff/source/schema/UI scope.

The next eligible post-execution slice may inspect one terminal selected pass as read-only status/execution proof only, and must not implement result review, package, handoff, rerun/recovery, source expansion, schema/runtime DB widening, UI activation, or qualitative/hybrid/RAG/vector behavior.

The next eligible post-status slice may record one bounded operator review decision for one terminal selected pass only after PR #222 result/status authority, and must not implement package review, handoff, rerun/recovery, source expansion, schema/runtime DB widening, UI activation, or qualitative/hybrid/RAG/vector behavior.

The bounded /review/layer3 UI may expose session refresh, selected-pass result/status inspection, and one result-review submission through existing backend endpoints only; execution selection/start UI, package review, handoff/export, rerun/recovery, new backend endpoints, source/schema/runtime widening, qualitative/hybrid/RAG/vector behavior, local upload/directory ingestion, and full mockup activation remain unavailable.

The next eligible post-result-review planning boundary may expose only read-only package-review readiness/preview after one approved selected-pass result review; durable package construction, package rows, materialize_package_entry(...) as-is, package payloads, package-review submission, and handoff/export remain unavailable until separately frozen.

PR #235 exposes a read-only package-review preview endpoint and UI inspection panel after one approved selected-pass result review, while preserving no package construction, package rows, package payloads, materialize_package_entry(...) call, package-review submit/commit, handoff/export, rerun/recovery, source/schema/runtime widening, execution selection/start UI, and full mockup activation.

The post-preview planning boundary defined package construction only: exactly one reconciliation row, three output-package rows, and three payload files after approved selected-pass result-review and matching package-preview authority. Package-review submit required separate docs 52/53 governance and PR #243 implementation; PR #251 later adds only backend/API prepare-only handoff/export state.

PR #238 exposes bounded package construction only: exactly one reconciliation row, three output-package rows, and three payload files after approved selected-pass result-review and matching package-preview authority. PR #243 is the separate backend submit implementation, and PR #251 later adds only backend/API prepare-only handoff/export state.

The next eligible post-construction planning boundary may define one operator package-review decision over an already constructed package set only; package payload mutation, reconstruction, handoff/export, source/schema/runtime widening, and full mockup activation remain unavailable until separately frozen.
